name: Jellyfin
description: Stream your own media with persistent libraries and a preconfigured administrator. Software playback works without privileged hardware access.

features.title: Persistent storage
features.description: Application data stays on project-scoped volumes across deployments.

features.title: Published images
features.description: Install pinned upstream containers without building images on your server.

fields.label: Admin username
fields.help: Used only for the initial account. Manage existing accounts in the app.

firstLogin.note: Account changes made in the app are preserved on redeployment. These are the initial credentials.

files.content:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
if grep -q '<IsStartupWizardCompleted>true</IsStartupWizardCompleted>' /config/config/system.xml 2>/dev/null; then
  touch /tmp/openship-ready
  exec /jellyfin/jellyfin "$@"
fi
# Keep setup bound to loopback. The real data directory stays on its persistent volume.
mkdir -p /config/config /tmp/openship-jellyfin
if [ -f /config/config/system.xml ]; then cp /config/config/system.xml /tmp/openship-jellyfin/system.xml; fi
cat > /tmp/openship-jellyfin/network.xml <<'XML'
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<NetworkConfiguration>
  <LocalNetworkAddresses><string>127.0.0.1</string></LocalNetworkAddresses>
  <EnableIPv6>false</EnableIPv6>
</NetworkConfiguration>
XML
/jellyfin/jellyfin --configdir /tmp/openship-jellyfin &
child=$!
trap 'kill -TERM "$child" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$child" || true' EXIT
trap 'exit 143' TERM INT
attempt=0
until curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8096/health 2>/dev/null | grep -qx Healthy; do
  kill -0 "$child"
  attempt=$((attempt + 1))
  [ "$attempt" -lt 180 ] || { echo 'Jellyfin private setup timed out.' >&2; exit 1; }
  sleep 2
done
json_string() {
  printf '%s' "$1" | od -An -v -tu1 | awk 'BEGIN { printf "\"" } { for (i = 1; i <= NF; i++) { if ($i == 34 || $i == 92) printf "\\%c", $i; else if ($i < 32) printf "\\u%04x", $i; else printf "%c", $i } } END { printf "\"" }'
}
[ -n "$OPENSHIP_ADMIN_USER" ] && [ -n "$OPENSHIP_ADMIN_PASSWORD" ]
curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8096/Startup/User >/dev/null
payload=$(printf '{"Name":%s,"Password":%s}' "$(json_string "$OPENSHIP_ADMIN_USER")" "$(json_string "$OPENSHIP_ADMIN_PASSWORD")")
# On an interrupted previous bootstrap, the password may already exist. Verify it before continuing.
if ! printf '%s' "$payload" | curl -fsS -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-binary @- http://127.0.0.1:8096/Startup/User >/dev/null; then
  payload=$(printf '{"Username":%s,"Pw":%s}' "$(json_string "$OPENSHIP_ADMIN_USER")" "$(json_string "$OPENSHIP_ADMIN_PASSWORD")")
  printf '%s' "$payload" | curl -fsS -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Authorization: MediaBrowser Client="Openship", Device="Setup", DeviceId="openship-setup", Version="1"' --data-binary @- http://127.0.0.1:8096/Users/AuthenticateByName >/dev/null
fi
curl -fsS -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8096/Startup/Complete >/dev/null
grep -q '<IsStartupWizardCompleted>true</IsStartupWizardCompleted>' /tmp/openship-jellyfin/system.xml
kill -TERM "$child"
wait "$child" || true
trap - EXIT TERM INT
cp /tmp/openship-jellyfin/system.xml /config/config/system.xml.new
mv /config/config/system.xml.new /config/config/system.xml
touch /tmp/openship-ready
exec /jellyfin/jellyfin "$@"
